subject.title: refactor(qqbot): adopt core typing keepalive loop with budget accounting intact

question: Should `createTypingKeepaliveLoop` become a supported public export on `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-outbound` for channel plugins with owner-specific typing policy?
rationale: The code is correct and the package-contract checks pass, but adding a public plugin API is a durable compatibility choice that should reflect maintainer intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Accept the public helper
options.body: Keep the narrow export and treat generic timer and in-flight orchestration as a supported plugin SDK capability.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Use another approved bundled-plugin runtime seam or retain local scheduling so external plugins cannot depend on this low-level lifecycle primitive.

recommendation.title: Accept the public helper
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow export and treat generic timer and in-flight orchestration as a supported plugin SDK capability.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the shared helper and QQ implementation and authored the linked channel-refactor program.
